rv.q: "Memorabilia" is still a very rewarding and unusual show and a piece of new work with formidable potential.
It is hilarious, it is touching, it is memorable.
From high-flying luchadores to a nimble nutty professor, Teatro Vista produces yet another gem, and the only thing that you’ll wrestle with is if you want to see “Memorabilia” a second time.
Jean Claudio's solo work Memorabilia now on view at Filament Theatre is a triumph of physical performance art.

cn.t: Jean Claudio's nearly wordless solo work wins acclaim for its impressive physical artistry and inventive visual design, delivering a moving, abstract exploration of memory that critics find both sweet and powerful.
